name: Biology
tagline: Field and lab science on a working river
summary: Study living systems from cells to ecosystems, with field work on the Calder River from your first semester.

Undergraduate research with faculty
Rooftop greenhouse and genomics lab
Pre-health advising
courses:
Cell Biology
Ecology of Rivers and Wetlands
Genetics
Animal Physiology
Senior Research Seminar
outcomes:
Medical and dental school
Environmental consulting
Graduate research
Public health
body:
Study living systems from cells to ecosystems, with field work on the Calder River from your first semester.

At Larkmoor, classes are small and taught by faculty, not teaching assistants. Most biology students work on a faculty project or an internship before they graduate, and every student has a faculty advisor from the first week.

How the program is built

The first two years cover foundations and let you explore. In the last two you choose electives, take on a larger project, and finish with a capstone that you present to faculty and peers.
